Lena (CS): @Ria Sapphire Labs requested a short APAC pilot next week: add two CIDRs to allowlist + temporary soft QPS increase to 380 for 4 days. Can infra & network confirm?
Ria (Sapphire Labs): Window 2026-05-10..2026-05-13. CIDRs: 198.51.100.192/28 and 203.0.113.160/27. Typical steady 180 qps, occasional spikes to 360. Read-only dashboard access for ops@sapphire.io please. Renewal conversation in 2 weeks so want smooth pilot.
Marco (Eng-Infra): Got it. Will this be pinned to a specific edge pool and do you want auto-revoke after 4 days? We'll also add soft quota alerts.
Ria (Sapphire Labs): Pin to ap-southeast-1 (apac-south). Auto-revoke=4 days. Please tag logs with "sapphire-pilot-0510".
Jules (Network): We have peering with their ASN but these CIDRs are new. TTL tagging ok. Recommend fallback to apac-2 if apac-south util >70% to avoid errors. We'll add path-flap alerts.
Marco (Eng-Infra): Draft ops config (account-scoped):
```json
{ "account":"sapphire","edge_pool":"apac-south","allowlist":["198.51.100.192/28","203.0.113.160/27"],"rate_limit":{"qps":380,"type":"soft"},"meta":{"pilot":"2026-05-10..2026-05-13","auto_revoke_days":4} }
```
Marco (Eng-Infra): CLI (ops-only):
```bash
redwood infra acl add --account sapphire --cidr 198.51.100.192/28 --tag sapphire-pilot-0510 --ttl 4d
redwood infra acl add --account sapphire --cidr 203.0.113.160/27 --tag sapphire-pilot-0510 --ttl 4d
redwood infra routing set --account sapphire --edge-pool apac-south --policy prefer
redwood infra rate update --account sapphire --qps 380 --type soft
```
Marco (Eng-Infra): Plan: schedule apply 2026-05-09T22:00Z, add soft quota alert at 75% predicted usage. Rollback if error rate >1% for 5m. I'll post telemetry 24h after start.
infra-bot: change job queued job-120045 by Marco; expected apply=2026-05-09T22:00:00Z.
Ria (Sapphire Labs): Thanks 44d. Please grant ops@sapphire.io read-only dashboard access and include sample eval prompts.
Lena (CS): I'll create ticket CS-9427 to track enablement, dashboard invite, and renewal note. Enablement slot 2026-05-09 16:00 PT. Tag #eng-oncall if anything spikes.
Marco (Eng-Infra): Will update this thread at job start and again after 24h with token/latency deltas.
Jules (Network): Noted. Adding monitoring for BGP and path flaps.
Lena (CS): Closing loop for now.
